headlines.summary: The company has unveiled its Forward2030 strategic plan at its Investor Day, targeting over €12 billion in revenue and an EBIT margin above 12.5% by 2030, with €1 billion in investment in in-house product development and a stable workforce of about 56,000 employees.

headlines.title: Around 3.7 million jobs are at risk in Europe's struggling industry, report says
headlines.summary: McKinsey estimates that about 3.7 million jobs are directly at risk in Europe, as almost half of the region's industrial companies were under financial stress or in distress in 2025. Early 2026 data suggest the decline is speeding up, but McKinsey says the problems can be fixed.

headlines.summary: From Nvidia to Coreweave, AI and tech stocks have swung sharply in recent months. Some investors still see plenty of room to run, while others are trying to diversify — and finding it harder than expected.

headlines.summary: BYD has entered exclusive talks to buy Ineos Automotive's Hambach plant in Moselle. The deal could let the top electric carmaker build in France and boost its European presence.

headlines.title: Nvidia reinstates former CEO Jensen Huang despite China espionage scandal
headlines.summary: Nvidia s board voted unanimously to bring back the disgraced CEO, who resigned this month amid news of his affairs. He s suspected of having had a relationship with a Chinese intelligence asset.

headlines.title: Spain's economy is booming. Why are real wages still below their 2009 peak?
headlines.summary: Spain's economy is forecast to grow more than twice as fast as the eurozone's this year, but average pay still buys less than it did in 2009. Rising housing and food costs are putting household budgets under pressure ahead of Sunday's election.

headlines.title: I ve lost her forever — Why German voice actors are refusing to sign Netflix s AI contract
headlines.summary: For decades, Germans have known Hollywood s biggest stars through the same familiar voices. Now an AI clause in Netflix contracts is splitting the industry over whether it protects performers or exposes them.

trend_headline: 유럽 제조업 위기와 美 관세 압박 동시 직면
summary: 유럽 산업계가 구조적 재정 스트레스와 미국의 신규 관세 위협이라는 이중고에 직면했습니다. 특히 독일 자동차 등 전통 제조업의 비용 부담이 가중되는 가운데, EU는 미국의 무역 압박에 반발하며 독자적인 공급망 방어 전략을 모색하고 있습니다.
key_points: 유럽 내 산업용 기업의 절반 가까이가 재정적 스트레스 상태이며 약 370만 개의 일자리가 위협받고 있음
미국 정부가 EU와 중국 등을 겨냥한 신규 관세 부치를 예고하면서 무역 긴장이 고조됨
